title: Syntax scan and CNF parsing
statement: For every finite binary string $x$, start the six-state syntax scanner in the formula-level state and apply its transition function successively to the bits of $x$. The scanner ends in the exact-end state if and only if the exact-consumption parser returns a CNF formula on input $x$.
replaced:
For every binary string $x$, the string $x$ is accepted by the six-state formula
syntax scan from the formula-level state if and only if the exact-consumption formula
parser succeeds on $x$.
